QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Into the Light
QuestInfo.0: The underlings of the Black Mage attacked the Temple of Time. That caused the Gate to the Future to open. What are the ramifications? Ask the #bTemple Keeper#k at the #bTemple of Time#k.
QuestInfo.1: The Temple Keeper said it's dangerous to leave the Gate to the Future open, and asked you to close it. Head for the #bGate to the Future#k and see what you can do.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to close the Gate to the Future, but somehow ended up inside of it. Take a look around and try to recover your bearings.

demand.base: #questorder1#Travel through the Gate to the Future (#R31102ExRef31102#)

0.conditionContent: Travel through the Gate to the Future

0.msg: Traveling into the future is a dangerous prospect -- too dangerous for us mortals to have any business attempting it. With that Gate open, I fear it'll cause chaos. There are already rumors swirling around, about what's 'going' to happen. Some people even think it's happening now.

2.msg: The details of the rumor are irrelevant. We can't even tell if that future is real or not. The real problem here is the chaos that rumor creates. And that's why the Goddess has forbidden us to see the future in the first place.

4.msg: We can't leave the Gate to the Future open. But that's easier said than done, even for me. Simply put, we need someone stronger than I am.

5.msg: #b(I can guess what he's going to say next...)#k

6.msg: So let me ask you. You've been through all kinds of adventures, built up your strength. If anyone can close the Gate, maybe you can.

yes.0: Please. The #bGate to the Future#k is just a little bit ahead, on the right.

no.0: Well, I can't MAKE you help, but if you didn't want to, why'd you come here?
